description: Searches open remote and hybrid jobs listed on Remotejobb.se, a Swedish job board. All filters are optional and combine with AND; a filter given several values matches jobs with any of them. Returns compact job summaries with paging, the applied order, and facets: the number of matching jobs per filter value, each counted with the other filters applied. Full descriptions and apply links are returned by get_job.

ad_language.description: Language the job ad is written in: "sv" (Swedish) or "en" (English). Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

category.description: Job category, as a slug or name. list_search_filters lists the categories. Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

city.description: City of hybrid jobs, as a name or slug, e.g. "Göteborg", "Gothenburg" or "goteborg". Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

company.description: Company name or slug. Names match loosely: case, accents, punctuation and legal suffixes such as "AB" are ignored, and every word must start a word of the company name, so "spotify" matches "Spotify AB". Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

employment_type.description: Type of employment. Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

language.description: Language for labels such as work mode and employment type. Job content is returned in its original language.

min_monthly_salary_sek.description: Minimum monthly salary in SEK. Yearly and hourly salaries are converted. Only matches jobs that state a salary in SEK.

order.description: Sort order. "relevance": best keyword match first (the default with a query). "published_at": newest first (the default without a query). "apply_by": earliest application deadline first, jobs without a deadline last. "salary": highest stated salary first, jobs without a salary last.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs published within this many days.

query.description: Keywords matched against job title, company name and description, e.g. "laravel developer". Every word must match, as a prefix.

remote_scope.description: Where applicants may live. Matches this scope and anything more open, e.g. "eu" also returns "europe" and "worldwide" jobs.

salary_only.description: Only jobs that state a salary.

work_mode.description: "remote" for fully remote jobs, "hybrid" for jobs that are partly on site. Accepts one value or a list; a list matches any of its values.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
